abstract.text: Build, transform, convert, and analyze musical works, and generate new ones
from templates.

inlineContent.text: IvorModel organizes music as a hierarchy of value types:

code: │  ├─ content:      Work.Content       // parts, plus a tempo map in beat time
│  ├─ info:         Work.Info          // titles, credits, rights, remarks
│  └─ realizations: [Realization]      // how instruments sound when played
└─ templates: [Template]               // analyses that generate new works
